name: Heshbon
brief: Amorite city conquered by Moses, allotted to Reuben
short: Heshbon, an Amorite city conquered by Moses (<ref="Num.21.25-30">Num.21.25-30</ref>), was allotted to Reuben (<ref="Num.32.37; Josh 13:17">Num.32.37; Josh 13:17</ref>) but later given to the Levites (<ref="Josh 21:39">Josh 21:39</ref>); it was a significant city in the region (<ref="Isa.15.4; 16:8-9; Jer.48.2, 34, 45; 49:3">Isa.15.4; 16:8-9; Jer.48.2, 34, 45; 49:3</ref>).
